description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex, a PHP-based HTML lexer that uses the PHP DOM extension to parse and tokenize HTML input into tokens. It includes methods for tokenizing HTML via DOM traversal, handling various node types, and wrapping HTML content, specifically tailored for HTML purification tasks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex
classes.description: A lexer class for parsing HTML using PHP's DOM extension, producing tokens for HTML purification.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Main method that normalizes, preprocesses, and tokenizes HTML input into tokens by leveraging DOMDocument parsing.

methods.name: tokenizeDOM
methods.description: Recursively traverses DOM nodes to generate a sequence of tokens based on node types.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Retrieves the tag name of a DOM node, compatible with various libxml versions.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data/content of a DOM node, compatible with various libxml versions.

methods.name: createStartNode
methods.description: Creates start tokens for element and text nodes, and handles special cases like CDATA and comments.

methods.name: createEndNode
methods.description: Creates end tokens for element nodes.

methods.name: transformAttrToAssoc
methods.description: Converts DOMNamedNodeMap of attributes into an associative array.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A no-op error handler used to suppress DOM loading errors.

methods.name: callbackUndoCommentSubst
methods.description: Reverts comment substitutions made during aggressive fix attempts.

methods.name: callbackArmorCommentEntities
methods.description: Entities comment content to prevent clobbering.

methods.name: undoCommentSubstr
methods.description: Reverts entity substitutions for comment content.

methods.name: wrapHTML
methods.description: Wraps HTML fragment in a standard HTML document structure, including DOCTYPE, html, head, meta, and body tags.

methods.name: aggressivelyFixLt
methods.description: Modifies HTML to fix stray less-than signs outside tags to prevent parsing issues.

methods.name: manipulateHtmlComments
methods.description: Processes HTML comments within the HTML content using a callback to modify comment content.
